env.note: Lattice time is the runtime work around the provider call: routing, request packing, policy, output checks, redaction, signing, and receipt build. Provider time is the fetch plus the full response body. Pacing sleeps, HTTP 429 backoff, and failed-attempt HTTP time are excluded from Lattice time and from the end-to-end denominator. An earlier header-only subtraction counted body download as Lattice time. max_tokens is 8192. Models that advertise a reasoning parameter also receive reasoning.effort=low; a 400 that rejects that field is retried once without it. Inkling's HTTP 403 on ordinary chat calls is recorded as unavailable.
env.timing: latticeMs excludes provider body, retries, and backoff; latticePct = 100 * latticeMs / (latticeMs + providerMs + retryProviderMs)
